_notes.Snow: Classifier has no intensity head; 'moderate' is the conservative default (BOUNDARY warning). Override to 'light' for permissive profiles.
_notes.Fog: Clamp resolves the GE500+Fog contradiction in favour of the degraded reading.
_notes.Haze_Dust: Treated as mild degradation: visibility_m capped at 200.
_notes.unlisted_weather: Sunny/Cloudy write no fields; the baseline covers rain/snow/fog negatives.
